_doc: Revision log of the ST185-harness drawing set (every harness of the car) (DECISIONS R200): DRAWN = the BY of Rev A and never changes; every BY is the initials of the person who REQUESTED the change (from %USERPROFILE%\.drawing-initials), never an agent or tool name. .01 clerical revs are not rows here (git history only). A full-letter rev from Rev B on lists what changed in `marks` (the rev triangle goes next to each).
title: ST185-harness - every wiring harness of the car, one drawing set
subtitle: All 12 harnesses of the master wire list (R221): the ECU harness (AB-cabin + AB-engine, R220), CabinPower, harness C, HeavyDC, CAN, CSB3, AntiTheft, ClusterLED, wheel speed front / rear, rear fuel. Rear lights stay on the factory harness.

revs.what: First issue: every harness of the master in one drawing set (replaces the ST185-AB-cabin pilot, Rev A 2026-10-19).
Surgical rewire written into the master: 21 decided circuits, D16 A/C, OEM starter / reverse / rear lights, fog cut-and-cap, bank IDs, RearLights harness dropped.
revs.marks: starter C11 to Aux 8; k_acc from A15 pin 8; Ign 8 tacho; EL814 headlight-sense; w_pdb_jb1 behind the dash; E10 cabin splice; R/B2 and R/B4 feeds

revs.what: A15 lock-sensor input takes a modified tacho: Ign 8 through 4.7 kΩ to pin 9 (N61 workaround).
Car-check answers: if the ignition-switch black-orange wire is at the engine plug, remove it; A/C sensor common stays; J/B1 feed sized 6 AWG for 60 A.
C11 is hardware starter interlock only; Aux 8 spare. Oil LED stays on CSB3 L4.
revs.marks: w_str85 removed; Aux 8 spare; oil LED CSB3 L4

revs.what: Each grouped section is its own page. A schematic page holds six wires, each in its own line colour; the label keeps the wire's gauge and colour. A crossing bumps over the other wire. Layout pages are the approved route drawings, including Routes 16 and 17 on 1993 EWD p.36 (Dan 2026-10-26 keep).
revs.marks: section pages; six-wire schematic; Routes 16 and 17

revs.what: Layout: the old Routes 2-7 (harness C, A / B engine, A / B cabin, cabin power) were wrong and are removed (Dan 2026-10-26). Route 16 and 17 and Routes 1, 8-14 stay; AB-cabin and CabinPower fall back to the physical tree.
Spare ECU pins A26 (Aux 8), B31 / B32 (An Volt 10 / 11) listed with sealing plugs. First per-harness From / To wire lists (AB-cabin, AB-engine) generated with the set.

Crank and cam each run in one shielded Raychem cable (2-core / 3-core). The CAN-Lambda branch is all ECU engine harness: shielded pair to splices and the 120R terminator behind the Lambda plug. Starter S crosses the bulkhead on cavity 3 (12 AWG, size 12). ECU-B 10 tach contact is the 20 AWG Superseal.
revs.marks: CAB-CRANK 2-core; CAB-CAM 3-core; CAN-Lambda terminator at plug; w_strl_c / w_strl_e on DRB102 3; w_tach contact

revs.what: ECU engine harness layout tree built from Route 16 (Dan's device spots and branches, DECISIONS B8) in place of the old Route 3 / 4 tree. Lengths = map length x 5.3 mm per EWD point + 300 mm drop for low parts (crank, knock, starter, VSS, reverse switch, oil pressure, oil temp, engine ground); estimates until measured. Engine splices sit where their legs part.
revs.marks: AB-engine tree from Route 16; AB-engine est. lengths

revs.what: Ignition coil ground goes straight to the glove-box POWER box NEG bar through bulkhead cavity 4 (12 AWG engine side, 14 AWG cabin side, like the coil feed on cavity 1), not to the engine block stud. Coil ground splice now at coil 4.
revs.marks: w_cop_gnd_e_ae / w_cop_gnd_ac on DRB102 4; ENG-GND-RING removed

revs.what: Every connector part-way along a line or run breaks out at least 6 in (152 mm) off it; the last connector on a line may end it (Dan 2026-10-29). Cam, coils 2-4 and CAN-Lambda get 6 in breakouts; stub taps drawn on the route line. The engine bulkhead sits 8 in (203 mm) above where the trunk meets the firewall: every engine harness wire from the bulkhead is 203 mm longer.
revs.marks: AB-engine est. lengths: cam, coils 2-4, CAN-Lambda; bulkhead 8 in drop (+203 mm on 63 bulkhead wires)

revs.what: Harness C (EngineRoom-C) layout on the Route 17 device spots; its lengths from the tree (Dan 2026-11-01)
revs.marks: EngineRoom-C tree from Route 17 (runs 10 / 11, RH fender grommet, Route 16 lines 9 / 6 / 4 / 2); EngineRoom-C est. lengths

revs.what: Ground studs EA / EB on Route 17 at their factory spots (1993 EWD p.36); their 9 wire lengths from the tree (Dan 2026-11-01)
revs.marks: Route 17 devices 24 / 25 with stubs to run 10; 9 EngineRoom-C ground wire est. lengths
